name: Pars Kit – پارس کیت
author: اَبرانا

sections.description:
Pars Kit is a lightweight, fast, and compact plugin for WooCommerce. It brings the practical tools Iranian stores need into one plugin.

Each feature stands on its own. Enable only the tools you need.

📆 Jalali (Shamsi) dates:

WordPress and WooCommerce dates are shown in the Jalali (Shamsi) calendar in the admin, on the site, in calendars, in date fields, and in emails.

The WooCommerce Analytics section and report date ranges are shown entirely in the Jalali calendar.

Date conversion is display-only. Dates stored in the database stay unchanged.

💳 Iranian bank payment gateways:

Pars Kit includes these Iranian bank payment gateways:

  • Behpardakht Mellat
  • Saman
  • Parsian (PEC)
  • Pasargad
  • Sadad (Bank Melli)
  • Iran Kish
  • Pardakht Novin Arian

🚀 Optimization and Speed ​​Enhancement:

Automatic WebP conversion — Images uploaded to the site are automatically converted to WebP, compressed, and reduced in size, without a loss of quality, so pages load much faster.

Limit outbound connections — You choose the allowed domains and apply the limit to the admin, the site, or both. Requests to domains outside that list are blocked, which speeds up the admin and the store, especially on hosting inside Iran.

✅ Admin activity log:

When this section is enabled, activity by users with administrative access to the admin is recorded in detail.

The username, IP address, date, time, and the action itself are stored. Filters by field and date range make review easier.

🧰 Useful WordPress and WooCommerce tools:

You can turn each tool on or off separately, with one click:

  • Persian digits in the admin — Numbers in the WordPress admin are shown with Persian digits.
  • Vazirmatn in the admin — The Vazirmatn Persian font in the WordPress admin.
  • Faster admin — Optimize the WordPress admin and make it faster.
  • Jalali order date filter — On the WooCommerce orders screen, search by a date or a date range.
  • Persian first and last name — On the checkout page, the first and last name are accepted only in Persian letters.
  • Hide the price when a product is out of stock — When a product is out of stock, its price is hidden on the shop and the product page.

✉️ SMTP email:

When SMTP is enabled, outgoing WordPress and WooCommerce email is sent through the server you enter in the plugin settings, and more messages are delivered successfully.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from WordPress.org, or upload the ZIP file.
  2. Activate Pars Kit.
  3. Open Pars Kit and enable the tools you need.
  4. For a bank gateway, after you enable it, enter the gateway details under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
sections.changelog:
2.1.41

  • Sale/order calendars no longer show a separate “today” caption. The day-cell outline remains.

2.1.40

  • Sale and order-edit calendars use the same Jalali popup as the orders list filter. Today is outlined and labeled. WordPress admin button CSS no longer breaks the day grid in Quick Edit.

2.1.39

  • Product Quick Edit: the Jalali sale calendar opens after WordPress clones #inline-edit (inline-edit-post.js). Native click listeners were lost on the copy; opening is delegated on document.

2.1.38

  • Product Quick Edit / bulk: Jalali sale dates (same _sale_price_dates_* fields as the product editor). The calendar is fixed to the viewport so WooCommerce product panels no longer clip it. Persian admin digits skip #woocommerce_inline_* / #inline_* data stores and keep price/stock/date inputs ASCII so Update saves.

2.1.37

  • Activity log: from/to lines use the word “به” instead of a Unicode arrow. The CSS chevron from 2.1.36 is removed. Older rows are shown the same way.

2.1.36

  • Activity log: the from/to arrow stays in reading order when Persian and English sit next to it.

2.1.35

  • Admin menu: the PK SVG uses fill=”black” so WordPress svg-painter follows the admin color scheme (add_menu_page).
  • Blocker: keep a safe data:image src on img when only a lazy-load attribute is stripped.

2.1.34

  • Date conversion: master switch is “Jalali date conversion”. WordPress admin and WooCommerce dates are one toggle. WooCommerce emails are labeled as email dates.

2.1.33

  • Tools: “Persian digits in the admin” is the first tools toggle (default on). Existing on/off values are kept. Jalali wp_date digits stay ASCII in email and on the storefront.

2.1.32

  • Parsian: cancelling on the bank page shows the Mellat notice (status -138 / 17). Other non-zero codes stay a generic unsuccessful return.

2.1.31

  • Catalog: after a WooCommerce email finishes, out-of-stock price hiding applies again in the same request.

2.1.30

  • Plugin Check: unslash REST query credentials, sanitize wc-ajax, and match Plugin Name to the readme title.

2.1.29

  • Gateways: cancelling on the bank page shows the same Mellat notice. Sadad callback -1 is a shopper cancel.

Older changes are in changelog.txt.
